world._place_why: Alumina is the crystal that becomes ruby or sapphire -- same body, another light. LUMINA = the lights, in Latin, with the apex in front. The name was the captain's (2026-10-22).
world._why: The first deck of the 0z metaverse. It is deliberately almost empty: a sea, one island, and numbered plots. Everything else is meant to be built by whoever arrives, not by us.

plots.when: the archive — where a record is kept
the workshop — where a thing is built
the school — where a newcomer is taught the four laws
the market — where a price becomes citable
the gate — the only door, and it only opens inward

rules: A claim is a row: plot, who, note, timestamp. Nothing is claimed by drawing over someone.
The public gate is read-only and always will be: POST there returns E_WORLD_READ_ONLY.
Claims are appended by the defender gate, never edited, never removed.
The zero at the centre belongs to nobody. It is where counting starts, not where someone lives.

chain.note: ADVENTURE 01 -- THE LOOP OPENS. The genesis is the ground; this is the first step on it. THE RULE OF THE STONE: ONE verified claim per day, appended here, each naming the hash of the row before it. No day can be skipped without leaving a visible gap -- the chain makes absence provable. DAY 1 (this row): the world has a root, a port (x.com/Luffy0xGen/status/2112444139769917505), a map (ONE VERSE e67f8337), a clock that reads the crowd (xloop --seed), a guard that counts the keys (secret_guard) and a maze with nine floors. CLASSIC DICE MEASURED (captain's order, 2026-10-25). EV = -0.01 x total wagered at EVERY chance (grid 2..98; payout 99/chance, measured -1.00000 pct per unit at all twelve points). Martingale from 1.00 at 0.01 stake, 49.5 pct chance: survives 6 consecutive losses, the 7th bet (0.64) cannot be covered; p(streak) = 0.505^6 = 1.66 pct per cycle, p(ruin within 100 cycles) = 81.2 pct. Monte Carlo, 2000 trials, seed 511, ruin = cannot cover the next bet, goal = 2x: ruin flat 36.45 pct / martingale 66.60 / anti-martingale 64.45 / 25-pct-of-bankroll 58.90; double before ruin 5.70 / 33.40 / 35.55 / 41.10 pct. CONCLUSION: no staking rule changes expectation; exposure does. REPRODUCE: python scripts/dice_lab.py --trials 2000. REPORT: docs/DICE_REPORT.md

DICE:02 -- THE HASH COLUMN IS A CHAIN (measured on the captain's 40-row suite, 2026-10-25). h(nonce-1) = SHA256(h(nonce)) held 39/39 links; the reverse direction held 0/39. Consequence: the next hash is computable offline, the past is verifiable, the chain cannot be walked back to a seed, and none of that yields the next MULTIPLIER. NEGATIVE RESULTS, all measured: sha256(nonce) 0/40, sha256(nonce+':') 0/40, sha256(mult) 0/40; seven provably-fair formulas x widths 2..32 bytes x every offset -> no window reproduces the multiplier on >=3 rows; shifts +-1,+-2 <=2/40; multiplier found inside its own hash 1/40. Old Italic reading (byte mod 27 -> U+10300+i) produced no readable text; log2(mult) had 34 distinct fractional parts in 40 rows (no 2^k clustering); 0 repeated 6-hex triads in 440 windows. Distribution consistent with a 1 pct-edge game. LIMIT: n=40, hand-transcribed; report docs/DICE_REPORT.md section 11.
